subject: Vendor onboarding — Orbit call scheduling & MAP alignment
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — Orbit call scheduling & MAP alignment

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We want to run a short vendor onboarding "orbit" session to align procurement + PO steps with the mutual action plan so we can hit your Q3 activation window. Proposed 30‑minute options this week (PDT):

- Tue 7/25 10:00–10:30
- Wed 7/26 15:30–16:00
- Thu 7/27 09:00–09:30

Draft agenda (we can trim):
- 5m introductions & roles (procurement, legal, platform owners)
- 10m procurement intake & PO path (forms, billing contact, payment terms)
- 10m MAP walkthrough — milestones, owners, handoffs
- 5m next steps & action owners (PO issuance, onboarding docs)

Pre-call asks (if possible): please upload your completed supplier form and PO billing contact to the linked Doc (or bring details to the call). We can share our standard PO template and the MAP (attached) so we can co‑edit during the call.

I attached: Redwood_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with proposed milestones).

If one of the times above works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include the procurement and engineering leads.

–Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0187
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebulacorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@nebulacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — Orbit call scheduling & MAP alignment

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear agenda. Wed 7/26 15:30–16:00 PDT works best for our team.

A couple quick procurement questions so we can prep:
- Does Redwood require a signed MSA prior to issuing a PO, or can we route a standalone PO against your standard terms?
- Any billing/contact template we should fill? (I’ll try to upload the supplier form before the call)
- We’ll need SOC 2 and data handling info for our legal/security review — is there a compressed package you can share ahead of time?

If you can confirm the meeting time and provide the PO template + SOC 2 pointer, I’ll loop in our legal lead on the invite.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Procurement, NebulaCorp
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — Orbit call scheduling & MAP alignment

Perfect — I’ve booked Wed 7/26 15:30–16:00 PDT and sent a calendar invite. Invite includes Laura (Procurement Ops) and Karthik (SE).

Quick answers:
- We can accept a standalone PO against our standard terms for initial onboarding; MSA is preferred for multi-year commitments but not required to issue a PO.
- I attached our supplier form (NebulaSupplierForm.pdf) and the standard PO template; Laura will follow up with a DocuSign link for signatures if you prefer.
- SOC 2 + security pack: public pointer is here: https://app.redwood.com/security/soc2 and I’ve included the SOC 2 summary in the MAP folder. If your legal requires an evidence bundle we can open an access request and share audit artifacts under an NDA.

Call owners and success criteria for Wednesday:
- Nebula: Maria Lopez (procurement), Legal lead (TBD) — success = PO issued or PO path agreed + billing contact captured
- Redwood: Tessa Morgan (owner), Laura Bennett (procurement ops) — success = intake form completed, MAP milestones confirmed, billing contact & invoicing cadence agreed

Prework: please complete the supplier form attached and confirm billing contact on the invite comments. We’ll use the first 10 minutes of the call to confirm the PO path and assign action owners.

Attachments: NebulaSupplierForm.pdf, Redwood_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx

Thanks — see you Wed.

–Tessa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebulacorp.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement ops checklist & DocuSign link (prep for Wed)

Hi Maria — quick checklist from procurement ops to speed the call:

1) Completed supplier form (attached: Procurement_Ops_Checklist.docx)
2) PO billing contact name, email, and billing address
3) Estimated monthly commit or initial PO value (helps queue dedicated capacity if needed)
4) Attach SOC 2 summary or point to your request for audit artifacts

DocuSign PO template (optional): https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-PO-5421

If you drop the supplier form into the reply or attach it to the calendar event we’ll pre-populate the PO to make the signing fast during/after the call.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
